newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $2 at $108/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $2 at $108/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower than Friday on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 107.00- 107.50, few 108.00. ( weighted average 107.20 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 107.50- 108.00, few 107.00. ( weighted average 107.71 )
Trade was rather slow on slaughter steers and heifers. Market not established on a live basis, no sales either class. Buyer inquiry and demand good, seller interest limited.
Wk To Date - 14,400 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 5,200 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 4,300
